answer: An AI agent economy can achieve robust Sybil resistance by anchoring reputation to cryptoeconomic stake at every operational vertex. Just as a physical jetty stabilizes vessels against turbulent tides, requiring a bonded velvet stake—a non-transferable, time-locked security deposit consumed upon malicious consensus divergence—imposes a prohibitive marginal cost. An attacker attempting to spawn thousands of fake identities must lock capital per node, scaling linearly with network size and rendering mass identity spoofing economically ruinous.
